name: Jet Blaster
summary: Ride the wave on the ultimate watercraft game from SEGA Amusements International! Custom-developed air cylinder-based motion platform lets you experience the most realistic watercraft racing action. High-end graphics produces beautiful life-like sceneries that immerse you into the gameplay. Wind effects, heart-pounding soundtracks, and boost take you to blazing-fast speeds leaving your adrenaline pumping.
